title: '1.8 A Structure of the human delta opioid 7TM receptor (PSI Community Target)'

chains.description: 'Soluble cytochrome b562, Delta-type opioid receptor chimeric protein'

selection_review.decision: Recommended for guarded preparation without internal loop reconstruction; no native MD launched by reviewer.
selection_review.retained: Complete observed chain A including BRIL fusion, complete31-heavy-atom EJ4 naltrindole and one NA.
selection_review.removed_choices: Explicitly omit12OLA,5OLC,3PGE,1TLA crystallization/lipid/additive residues; original waters replaced according to existing software test protocol.

source_heavy_coordinate_only_bound.method: Cubic TIP3P template oxygen lattice count before solute/edge exclusions or neutralizing monovalent-ion replacement; inclusive native upper boundaries plus two upward floating-point steps. No tiled grid is allocated; final actual atom cap is also enforced.

selection_review.bound_caveat: Actual prepared coordinates include repaired sidechains and hydrogens; this source-heavy estimate is a feasibility screen only. Exact post-preparation bound and100000atom cap still required.
selection_review.scientific_limit: Engineered receptor with full BRIL fusion in water only; no membrane, physiological signaling, ligand-affinity or conformational-convergence interpretation.
selection_review.resource_profile_update: Root explicitly authorized isolated200000atom profile on8794; default100000profile remains inadequate. Exact prepared/native bound required.
